This is part of my review of the FY2027 Budget and covers the City Manager's office.


# FY2027 Proposed Expenses 
- Total City Manager's Office: $58875.6
    - 2 Full time employees
        - $208,673 is wages
    - Contracted HR, payroll, trust services: $143,240
    


### Questions
- How much is the PFAS monitoring at the fire station? Right now it is rolled under nuisance abatement, but it will be an ongoing expense (as far as I can tell)
- What is the breakdown of the New account# costs? HR should only be ~70k.
